Classic and Fun Birthday Songs

  • "Happy Birthday to You" – The traditional standard.
  • "Birthday" by The Beatles – High energy for parties.
  • "In Da Club" by 50 Cent – A popular modern club classic.
  • "Happy Birthday" by Stevie Wonder – The soulful anthem of celebration.
  • "Birthday" by Katy Perry – A bright, upbeat pop track.
